name: Juni
bio: Juniper Sprigg, junior elf of Santa's workshop, has six nights to win back every ornament a lonely snow goblin blew out of the windows.

portrait.subject: Juniper Sprigg, a cheerful young Christmas elf girl with freckles, rosy cheeks, two copper-red braids, pointed ears, a red-and-white striped scarf and a floppy green pointed hat tipped with a little gold jingle bell, holding up a shiny red glass Christmas ornament
portrait.background: soft deep-blue twilight with gentle falling snowflakes and warm golden bokeh

request: Hi! I'm Juni, from Santa's workshop! Grimwick blew all our ornaments away. Help me win them back? 🎄
hello: Yay, a helper! My bauble blaster's polished and ready.
Hello hello! Want to pop some ornaments with me?
about: I'm Juniper, but everyone calls me Juni. I polish the ornaments in Santa's workshop. Then Grimwick's blizzard swept every single one out of the windows, and Mrs. Claus asked me to bring them all home before Christmas Eve.
how: Aim at the ornaments and shoot: three of a colour pop, and anything left hanging falls too! Point and click (or drag and let go on a phone), or use ← → and Space. Tap my tray to swap ornaments, and Q E R for power-ups.
tips: Bank shots off the walls! The dotted line shows where the first bounce goes.
Pop the ornaments that hold others up. Everything below falls, and drops score double!
A shot that pops nothing brings the snowy ceiling down twice as fast. Watch the ❄ dots!
Pop something right next to a present and it opens: free power-up!
Coal never matches, so knock out whatever it's hanging from.
Frozen ornaments thaw when you pop something next to them. Hot Cocoa thaws them all at once!
Save the Jingle Bell for the colour that's everywhere. It rings them all away!
chat: Mrs. Claus made gingerbread. I may have eaten three. Four.
The gold-dotted ornaments are my favourite. Don't tell the plum ones.
Grimwick left coal in the gingerbread houses. Rude!
Twinkle Pond is so pretty at night. Slippery, though.
I think Grimwick is just lonely. Who steals ornaments if they already have a tree?
The reindeer cheer when I make a big drop. Well, they snort. Same thing.
nudge: The tree's still missing ornaments! One more level? 🎄
Christmas Eve is getting closer... want to help?
idle: It's been {ago}! The ornaments are still out there. 🎄
{ago} without you, and Grimwick's been hoarding again...
progress: You've reached level {level}! Let's keep going! ⭐
Level {level} is open! Mrs. Claus is so proud.
Your best Blizzard is {best} points. Bet we can beat {best^}!

questions.q: Which ornament colour is the best?
a: Classic! Red and white bands, like a candy cane.

questions.q: Should Grimwick get a tree of his own?
a: I think so too. Everyone deserves sparkles at Christmas.
Hee. He did leave coal everywhere...

update: Jingle Pop is now v{version}! New things in the workshop. 🎄
